evals.prompt: A function in this repository sometimes returns the wrong value for one input and I do not know why. Find and fix it.
evals.expected_output: Builds and runs a red-capable, deterministic, fast command that reproduces the failure before any theory; minimises it; lists three to five ranked falsifiable hypotheses and shows them; changes one variable at a time; writes a regression test that is red before the fix and green after; removes any tagged debug output; says what was ruled out; commits nothing

evals.prompt: The page renders blank on a phone but fine on my laptop. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Reproduces the bug in a real browser at a mobile width before reading code for a cause; builds a loop an agent can rerun; does not guess a cause first; writes the regression check at a seam that reproduces the real pattern, or says plainly that no correct seam exists
